source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: Units with a Leader or Support ability (24.22, 24.34) are called leader and support units; either ability lets them lead other friendly units, called bodyguard units, to make an attached unit, which is treated as one unit by every rule. Each leader or support unit may lead only the bodyguard units named for it in the Warhammer app. Certain units carry rules saying that if the bodyguard unit of an attached unit gets destroyed, the leader/support units it had become separate units at their original starting strengths. For any attached unit covered by such a rule, this core rule says that once its bodyguard unit is destroyed, all the leader/support units concerned stay together as one unit in every respect.
